snippet.title: Liftoff Micro Drones - Launch Announcement
snippet.description:
Liftoff: Micro Drones is officially leaving Early Access on August 4th!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1432320/Liftoff_Micro_Drones/

Thanks to incredible community feedback over the years, we’ve transformed the sim from a modest start into a full-featured experience. At launch, Liftoff: Micro Drones offered 3 drones and 3 locations. Now, the V1 release will include 24 drones, 7 locations (14 level variations), Steam achievements, a complete UI polish and a brand-new track editor
